short_description: Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game and join Hanna’s adventure in the vibrant city of Eriksholm. The mysterious disappearance of her brother, Herman, ignites a chain of catastrophic events that will forever change their lives and the fate of the entire city.
steam_categories: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Full controller support; Custom Volume Controls; Playable without Timed Input; DualSense Controller Support; Steam Cloud; Family Sharing
